blocks.title: Unified Modeling Language (UML)
blocks.text: Unified Modeling Language (UML) software nizam ka design dikhane ka mayaari tareeqa hai. Yeh developers ko samajhne mein madad deti hai ke nizam kaise kaam aur rabta karta hai, aur pecheeda nizamon ko samajhna aur sambhalna aasan banati hai.
UML teen software engineers, Grady Booch, James Rumbaugh aur Ivar Jacobson, ne banai, jinhein aksar UML ke 'Three Amigos' kaha jata hai (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: UML kis ne banai, aur yeh kyun aham hai?
blocks.explanation: Grady Booch, James Rumbaugh aur Ivar Jacobson ne; yeh nizam ke design ki mayaari tasweeri zaban deti hai, jis se pecheeda nizam samajhna aur sambhalna aasan hota hai.

items: UML: software design ki mayaari tasweeri zaban; pecheeda nizam samajhna aur sambhalna aasan; Booch, Rumbaugh aur Jacobson ne banai.
